in_hebrew.long_meaning: A Hebrew name derived from the root word 'vdl' which means 'to sell' or 'to buy'. Valeda may mean 'she who sells or buys much' or 'wealthy, prosperous'.

in_greek.name: Βαλέδα
in_greek.long_meaning: A Greek name derived from the word 'balados' which means 'strong' or 'powerful'. Valeda may be a variant of the name Balada or Baldea.

in_latin.name: Valeda
in_latin.long_meaning: A Latin name derived from the word 'valere' which means 'to be strong' or 'to be healthy'. Valeda may mean 'strong' or 'powerful'.
